title: Unit Event — Star of Your Own Story — Episode8 Becoming The Character

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime have decided to work with other troupes, starting with the long-established Shunmeiza. Given a minor role with just three lines, Tsukasa faces a seemingly impossible task: to convince the director that his character is a real person.

rows.Line: The day of the play
Shunmeiza - Studio
se_event_supporting_2023_004

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This crowd feels really different from the ones we're used to...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'm seeing quite a few elderly patrons, as well as many coming alone. This must be Shunmeiza's core demogra—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh...
Those two are already getting ready.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We should do the same, Emu.
Let's give them a good show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm ready...
I've got a good image in my head.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I need to do my best.
I can't let Tsukasa hog the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Nakayama is twenty-eight years old. Three years Hino's senior.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's from Hakata and was the best student at his high school. He's personable and well-liked, but does not like to lose.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He was hired to become an editor for Shiranami in 1926. He sees his cool and successful junior, Hino, as his rival...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Every sinew of my body knows this story now...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Focus.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Your job is to present this one page from the book of Nakayama.)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member A
rows.Line: “The old gramophone in the parlor was playing something I hadn't heard in a very long time.”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member A
rows.Line: “Hearing that warm and beautiful sound made up my mind. To end my life here and now.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's begun...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa appears right at the beginning.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Kishi speaks with Hino, and Hino returns to the office.)

rows.Speaker: Hino
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
What a mess. But I need to tell the chief.”

rows.Speaker: Hino
rows.Line: “Good morning.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Enter Nakayama, who replies...)

rows.Speaker: Nakayama
rows.Line: “Morning.”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member F
rows.Line: “What took you so long to get back, Hino?”

rows.Speaker: Nakayama
rows.Line: “That novelist giving you trouble again?”

rows.Speaker: Hino
rows.Line:
“Bingo.
Chief, he asked for another extension. He's really cutting it close this time.”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member F
rows.Line: “Honestly, that no good...”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member F
rows.Line:
“This will be his last month.
'Shiranami' may mean 'white-crested waves', but we don't want anyone taking the magazine through rough seas.”

rows.Speaker: Hino
rows.Line: “Understood.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Is it just me, or does Tsukasa seem...?)

rows.Speaker: Nakayama
rows.Line: (What a great feeling.)

rows.Speaker: Nakayama
rows.Line: (This is what he gets for acting all cocky after being chosen as Awaji's editor.)

rows.Speaker: Nakayama
rows.Line: (Enjoy being tormented by that good-for-nothing novelist.)

rows.Speaker: Nakayama
rows.Line: “No choice, I suppose.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Yes...!
This is nothing like what he did during practice...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Those expressions and movements aren't written in the script.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They're the result of him directly feeling Nakayama's emotions.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa's disappeared into Nakayama.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, that's...)

rows.Speaker: Hino
rows.Line: “I'm going to the print shop...”
se_walk_men_002_1
After the play

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Everyone, you all did an excellent job.
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I asked each of you to accomplish a small task leading up to this performance.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I'd like to go around now and give an assessment of how you each did.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Starting with Yata, who played Kishi...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Next, Kusanagi, our Yuriko.
You succeeded in the task I gave you to make sure to exaggerate your movements while still making them look natural.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: However, you shrink up again whenever you lose focus, so try to keep the audience constantly in mind while you move.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I-I'll do that...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Last but not least, Nakayama. Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes?!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Your performance felt very out of place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Mr. Kato's right...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa did everything he could to make Nakayama feel like a real human being. And he paid the price by...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (...making his character stand out too much.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Actors can't just focus on the roles they're given.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They have to think about how their character fits into a play. They need to take center stage during certain scenes, while melding into the background during others... They have to constantly keep those things in mind.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I mentioned that to him on several occasions as we practiced, and he was striking a good balance up until today.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But today... He was too absorbed in the role.)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: During that scene, Tenma, you basically stole the spotlight from Kishi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(...
He's right.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I became so obsessed with making my character feel real that I forgot about fitting into the play as a whole...)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Even though that scene was very short, I was able to see your character's life story.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: So, you've succeeded in the task I gave you. Next time, try to think about the play as a whole while maintaining your fervent passion for acting.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
It won't be easy...
But I wish you the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Congratulations, Tsukasa!
Hip hip hooray!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not sure I deserve to be congratulated. I mean, I did sort of stick out like a sore thumb during the show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But you took a pretty big step.
I think you should be happy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
She's right, Tsukasa.
You managed to break out of your shell.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All of you...!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Tenma! Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Bakuno!
Nice work today!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Likewise.
Thanks to all of you, I ended up having a lot of fun putting on this play. Also...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?
No, we should be the ones thanking you...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
That's not true.
Meeting you, Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: You made me want to try being the lead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: As I mentioned the other day, my goal as an actor has been to shine a light on characters who I think deserve more attention.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: But something hit me while talking to you, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: It doesn't matter if a character's in a leading or supporting role...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I realized that for me, the fun part of playing characters has been considering their lives as I do.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Labelling characters as “leading” or “supporting” is disrespectful in a way since they're still human beings with lives of their own.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bakuno...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I've turned down several offers before, but I've decided to be proactive and ask to play the lead in a movie...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What...?!
Really?!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Yes.
You gave me the push I needed, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: So, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I helped you?! I'm so honored!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Despite receiving so much help this time around, I wasn't able to produce any results on stage...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I was able to take another big step as an actor.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I could make Bakuno smile.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(So!
I should take what I experienced and use it to propel myself further forward!)

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: The movie I'm about to work on is also going to include a few others from Shunmeiza...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
But they still need more extras.
So, if you'd like, would you all like to apply to be in it?

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line: A movie...?!
